vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nm-attune-project-planning
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides a structured framework for project planning, including architecture design, task breakdown, and sprint scheduling. While SKILL.md contains instructions for the agent to automatically transition to an execution phase without user confirmation, this is presented as a standard workflow orchestration feature rather than a malicious bypass. No evidence of data exfiltration, unauthorized execution, or obfuscation was found.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only project-planning template that asks for no credentials, binaries, or installs and its requirements align with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name and description (dependency-ordered implementation plans, phased tasks) match the SKILL.md content. The skill is purely instructional and doesn't request unrelated resources or privileges.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md is a detailed planning methodology and templates (architecture, file-structure, task breakdown, dependency graph, sprint planning). It does not instruct the agent to read arbitrary system files, access environment variables, or transmit data off-board. It does reference delegating to other internal skills (spec-kit, superpowers) but that is expected for a composable planning skill.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files are present (instruction-only). Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by this skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths — appropriate for a planning/template skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and model invocation is allowed (normal). The skill does not request persistent system presence or modify other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an offline planning/template guide and appears internally consistent. Before installing or using it: 1) Be cautious when feeding the agent real repository contents or credentials — the skill asks you to list file paths and decomposition, but it does not need direct access to your repo or secrets; provide only the specification and file list you intend to share. 2) Note the skill may delegate to other skills (spec-kit, superpowers, or the Claude Code plugin) — review those delegated skills/plugins separately for their permissions and installs. 3) If you plan to automate this against your codebase, ensure the automation layer (other plugins or connectors) is trusted and least-privilege.
